invalid_topic.description: Topic name does not match the topic grammar.

message_too_large.description: Message body exceeds 4096 bytes (use an attachment).

unsupported.description: Feature not supported in this version (e.g. X-Delay).

signature_required.description: Topic policy requires a device signature.

bad_signature.description: Signature does not verify against the sender id.

insufficient_balance.description: Payer balance cannot cover the worst-case cost. Body carries shortfall_usd_micros.

no_funded_owner.description: Anonymous publish to a topic with no funded owner.

forbidden.description: Token scope or policy forbids this action.

spend_cap_exceeded.description: A token, topic, or account spend cap would be exceeded.

transport_denied.description: Policy leaves no allowed transport for a required delivery.

topic_paused.description: Topic, device, or account kill switch is on.

conflict.description: Resource already exists or idempotency key reused with a different body.

rate_limited.description: Rate or burst limit reached. Retry-After is set.
